 Now Reading Your 2026 Halloween Horror-Scope Is Here
 Story from Horoscopes ADVERTISEMENT Your 2026 Halloween Horoscope ​​​​By Zodiac Sign Is Here
 Lisa Stardust Last Updated October 27, 2026 , 11:00 AM 
 Illustrated by Ben Tuber Happy Halloween, everyone! The veil between realms is thinnest this year, thanks to the two planetary retrogrades we are experiencing and the gentle, watery vibes that are intensifying our emotions and reactions. The sun will be in Scorpio, and the Waning Gibbous Moon will be in Cancer, aspecting Mercury retrograde in Scorpio and Venus retrograde in Libra . It'll be a time when ghosts will want to come out of the woodwork on the spookiest night of the year. The moon in Cancer will encourage us to tap into our intuition, while Mercury retrograde in Scorpio asks us to reflect on the past and expect more mishaps throughout the day. Venus's moonwalk in Libra will make us feel like we aren't at the peak of our game and contemplate who we want to spend Halloween with. Expect the unexpected and prepare for anything because this Hallow’s Eve is more thrilling and chilling than any haunted house or scary movie — mostly because the guest stars are uninvited to do the monster mash. Advertisement Read your Halloween horoscope below: DashDividers_1_500x100 Aries 
 Aries, chilling in a mellow setting in your comfort zone and element creates a cozy Halloween. Watching old horror or comedy films with friends and family at home allows you to welcome trick-or-treaters. Surrounding yourself with amazing vibes is the best way to celebrate, since you've been yearning for downtime. DashDividers_1_500x100 Taurus 
 Taurus, you're having a cheeky moment that makes you an instigator as you stir up hijinks with pals who have been more naughty than nice throughout the year. The shenanigans might stir the pot, so don't push matters to the max; know when to stop the games and be nice. DashDividers_1_500x100 Gemini 
 Gem, you want to participate in the holiday, but you only put in minimal effort into the decor and treats. It’s not that you're cheap; you are anticipating financial setbacks from the two ongoing retrogrades and trying to cut back on unnecessary items — maybe revive last year’s costume to save money. DashDividers_1_500x100 Cancer 
 Cancer, everyone is focusing their energy on you, allowing your aura to glow like the most popular crab in town. Halloween makes you feel as though you are the lead role in a movie, although hopefully you will beat the monsters and win in the end by utilizing your protective pinchers. DashDividers_1_500x100 Leo
 Leo, think of your disguise as a shield of armor. You will gain the courage to approach anyone because it’ll defend against your insecurities. Not that you aren't a robust individual, but your self-assurance has been a little off until now. A mask is a great way to heighten your rizz. Advertisement DashDividers_1_500x100 Virgo 
 Virgo, miscommunications with your friend group may ensue, like when you're meeting up or when someone wearing the same costume as you, even though you told them your attire weeks ago. Don't let it ruin your night, and choose to have a good time instead of stressing over the small stuff. DashDividers_1_500x100 Libra 
 Libra, when your boss calls, their demands might be difficult to ignore. Rather than skipping out on your plans to burn the midnight oil at the office, find balance by waking up early to finish the remaining tasks the following day. Doing so may be tough, but a compromise you’ll make. DashDividers_1_500x100 Scorpio 
 Scorpio, wishful thinking will open your mind to decide how you wish to proceed with an ex you unavoidably bump into or randomly decide to send a flirty text (conversely, they might reach out). Think before responding because it may be more of a trick than a treat to see them. DashDividers_1_500x100 Sagittarius 
 Sag, it's a sensitive time, when you can connect with spirits from the other side. Call upon your coven for a séance to see what the information is and how it applies to your life. Be careful and tell the apparitions goodbye to close the circle. Otherwise, they'll be yapping 24/7. DashDividers_1_500x100 Capricorn 
 Cap, believe it or not, Halloween is a romantic time for you. Don’t get me wrong, there will be blunders that transpire, but overall, it’ll cultivate an immense bond between you and the person you share the night with. The chaos becomes a factor in DTR because they are a trooper. Advertisement DashDividers_1_500x100 Aquarius 
 Aquarius, you're over the moon to treat your colleagues to a round at happy hour, but you won't be delighted if they expect you to foot the bill. Make sure you do not keep an open tab on your credit card and that they pay drink by drink. You are not bankrolling the scene. DashDividers_1_500x100 Pisces
 Pisces, the evening brings highs and lows, so don't go too far from your dwelling; instead, head to your neighborhood tavern for a round of trivia with your buddies. You may feel overwhelmed or overstimulated, so it's best not to travel too far as insurance in case you're abruptly done hanging. Advertisement
